tools.name: list_hotels
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which hotels or properties they manage in Hotelumo, or a hotel's id is needed. Returns each hotel's id, name, currency, language and timezone, 20 per page by default (no addresses or guest data). Not for room availability.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one hotel's setup, such as its default check-in and check-out times, currency, country or timezone. Returns the hotel's name, currency, language, timezone, country code and default check-in and check-out times, or not-found. Not for room availability or prices.

tools.name: get_hotel_availability
tools.description: Use this when someone asks if rooms are free for certain dates or what a stay would cost. Returns the room types and rate plans with a free room every night for the party, with rooms left and nightly and total prices in minor currency units. Stays of 1–30 nights, check-in within 365 days. Not for ma

tools.name: get_hotel_schedule_summary
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how busy the hotel is, or how many arrivals, departures or in-house stays fall on each day. Returns daily counts of confirmed, checked-in and checked-out stays plus reservation totals by status, for 7 days from today by default and at most 31 days; counting stops at 500. N

tools.name: list_room_types
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what kinds of rooms a hotel offers or how many guests each room type sleeps. Returns each room type's id, hotel, name and maximum guests, sorted by name, 20 per page by default. Not for whether a room type is free on given dates.

tools.name: get_room_type
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one room type, such as its name or how many guests it sleeps. Returns the room type's name, hotel and maximum guests, or not-found. Not for its prices or free dates.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which rooms are clean, dirty or inspected, or which are out of order or out of service. Returns each physical room's name or number, room type and hotel with its room and housekeeping status, 20 per page by default (no guest or occupant data). Not for which rooms are free

tools.name: list_rate_plans
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what rate plans a hotel sells, such as room-only or breakfast-included rates, and their base prices. Returns each plan's title, room type, base price in minor currency units, meal plan, per-room or per-person pricing and default flag, 20 per page by default. Not for prices

tools.name: list_daily_rates
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what a rate costs on specific nights, or about minimum stays, stop-sell or closed-to-arrival dates. Returns the stored per-day price and restrictions of one rate plan over up to 90 days; days without a row use the plan's base price. Not for whether rooms are free.

tools.name: list_extras
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what extras a hotel sells, such as breakfast, parking, spa, transfers or fees, and what they cost. Returns each active extra's name, price in minor currency units, currency, category and taxable flag, 20 per page by default. Not for what a guest bought or was charged.

tools.name: show_hotel_overview
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a quick overview or dashboard of one hotel's operations. Returns an overview card with the hotel's details, reservation status counts for the next 7 days, and room, room-type, room-status and housekeeping counts from bounded samples (no guest, stay or payment data).
